rule: A phone-to-phone handoff file: gzipped UTF-8 JSON, built and read with no connection. A received bundle is untrusted input, so the format has no field that could name or overwrite an existing row: no ids, no owner, no author. Importing always creates, and is idempotent on bundleId (plus Idempotency-Key on the server).
fileName: {Prefix}_Questionnaire_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{Form-Title}_Handoff.{ext} (the naming skill's helpers; Prefix DesignWorkshop or FieldRepository)

envelope.v: 2 (an importer refuses a higher major version with BUNDLE_VERSION)
envelope.bundleId: random 128-bit hex, minted when the file is built
envelope.sessions: optional, reserved for a later version; v2 importers ignore it
envelope.answers: optional, reserved for a later version; v2 importers ignore it

v1: designer-portal Android's first format (no 'v' 2, no bundleId): still read; its questions map field for field.
